finops.costExplorer.BreakdownCreation.description: Parameters of a cost breakdown computation

currency.description: Currency to keep, for example EUR: only the cost lines billed in this currency are kept. Needed only when the cost lines of the range hold a non-zero cost in more than one currency. Null keeps every currency. The computation then ends in ERROR when more than one currency is present, and the error message lists them.

filters.description: Filters on the cost lines. A cost line is kept when it passes every filter, and a dimension without a filter keeps every value. Null or empty keeps every cost line.

granularity.description: Finest width of a period. The computation uses a coarser one when the range holds more than 744 periods of this width.

groupBy.description: Key of the dimension whose values split the cost into series, as GET /v2/finops/costExplorer/dimension lists it. Null groups by CATEGORY.

to.description: End of the range, excluded. It must be after from.

finops.costExplorer.BreakdownFilter.description: Keeps only the cost lines whose value of the dimension is one of the values

dimension.description: Key of the dimension to filter on, as GET /v2/finops/costExplorer/dimension lists it. Two filters of the same breakdown cannot name the same dimension.

values.description: Values to keep, at least one, as POST /v2/finops/costExplorer/dimensionValue lists them. The comparison is exact and case-sensitive. An empty string keeps the cost lines that have no value for the dimension.

finops.costExplorer.BreakdownResult.description: Cost of a range, split into periods and into series

currency.description: Currency of every amount, for example EUR. Null when the range holds no cost.

granularity.description: Width of the periods. It is the requested granularity, or a coarser one when the range holds more than 744 periods of the requested width.

periods.description: Cost of each period, in time order

series.description: Values of the groupBy dimension present in the result, by total cost descending. Each one is a key of the amounts of every period and of totals. An empty string groups the cost lines that have no value for the dimension.

timezone.description: IANA time zone that the periods align with. Always UTC for now.

totals.description: Cost of each series over all the periods, in the currency of the breakdown, keyed by the values of series

truncated.description: Whether cost data is missing for a part of the range, so the amounts of that part are incomplete

finops.costExplorer.BreakdownTask.description: Asynchronous computation of a cost breakdown, and its result. The computation is kept for a limited time after its last update. It is then no longer found.

createdAt.description: Date when the computation was started

errors.description: Errors that ended the computation. Empty unless the status is ERROR.

result.description: Cost breakdown. Null unless the status is DONE.

status.description: Status of the computation: PENDING, RUNNING, DONE or ERROR. DONE and ERROR are final.

finops.costExplorer.CurrencyEnum.description: Currency of the cost lines: an ISO 4217 code, or POINTS

finops.costExplorer.Dimension.description: Attribute of the cost lines that a cost breakdown can filter on or group by

key.description: Identifier of the dimension, for example CATEGORY, as the groupBy and the filters of a cost breakdown take it

label.description: Display name of the dimension, in English, for example `Product category`

finops.costExplorer.DimensionValueCreati.description: Parameters of a dimension values listing

to.description: End of the range, excluded. It must be after from.

finops.costExplorer.DimensionValueList.description: Values of one dimension present in the cost lines of a range

dimension.description: Key of the dimension that the values belong to, as GET /v2/finops/costExplorer/dimension lists it

values.description: Distinct values of the dimension in the cost lines of the range, sorted. Each one can feed a filter of a cost breakdown. An empty string stands for the cost lines that have no value for the dimension.

finops.costExplorer.DimensionValueTask.description: Asynchronous listing of the values of every dimension in the cost lines of a range, and its result. The listing is kept for a limited time after its last update. It is then no longer found.

createdAt.description: Date when the listing was started

errors.description: Errors that ended the listing. Empty unless the status is ERROR.

result.description: Values of each dimension, in the order of GET /v2/finops/costExplorer/dimension. Null unless the status is DONE.

status.description: Status of the listing: PENDING, RUNNING, DONE or ERROR. DONE and ERROR are final.

finops.costExplorer.GranularityEnum.description: Width of a period of a cost breakdown. Periods align with UTC hours, days or months.

finops.costExplorer.Period.description: Cost recognized during one period of a cost breakdown, split into series

amounts.description: Cost of each series during the period, in the currency of the breakdown, keyed by the values of series. Every series has an entry.

end.description: End of the period, excluded, in UTC. The last period ends at the to of the range.

start.description: Start of the period, included, in UTC. The first period starts at the from of the range.

finops.costExplorer.TaskError.description: Error that ended a cost explorer computation

class.description: Class of the error: - Client::BadRequest::CurrencyRequired: the cost spans several currencies. Start the breakdown again with one of those the message lists. - Server::ServiceUnavailable::Timeout: start again over a shorter range. - Server::ServiceUnavailable::Interrupted: start again. - Server::InternalServerError: unexpected failure.

finops.costExplorer.TimezoneEnum.description: IANA time zone that the periods of a cost breakdown align with
